description: Test implementation of a simple QUIC framer visitor and a wrapper class for processing QUIC packets in tests.

classes.name: SimpleFramerVisitor
classes.description: Implements QuicFramerVisitorInterface to handle and record various QUIC frame events during packet processing.

classes.name: SimpleQuicFramer
classes.description: Wrapper class that manages a QuicFramer and a visitor to process QUIC packets and access parsed frames and headers.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a QUIC encrypted packet using the internal framer and visitor.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal visitor to a new instance.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the header of the last processed packet.

methods.name: version_negotiation_packet
methods.description: Returns the version negotiation packet if present.

methods.name: last_decrypted_level
methods.description: Returns the last decryption level of the processed packet.

methods.name: framer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: num_frames
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames processed in the last packet.

methods.name: ack_frames
methods.description: Returns the ACK frames from the last processed packet.

methods.name: coalesced_packet
methods.description: Returns the coalesced packet if available.
